  "problem": "`getaddressinfo` still returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address.     "\"Since #32618, `getaddressinfo` returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. It was kept and marked '(DEPRECATED)' so it could be removed later without surprising users... but it was never put behind `-deprecatedrpc`.\" (PR description)",
    "Release notes for v30 claimed the field was already removed from all RPCs, while `getaddressinfo` still emitted it. (PR description, commit 375dc869d8)"

result.summary: Deprecates the `iswatchonly` output field of the `getaddressinfo` RPC by gating it behind `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly`. The field has unconditionally returned `false` since watch-only support was removed in #32618.
result.problem: `getaddressinfo` still returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. While marked as deprecated in RPC help text and mistakenly described in the v30 release notes as removed from all RPCs, it was never placed behind the standard `-deprecatedrpc` mechanism prior to complete removal.
evidence: "Since #32618, `getaddressinfo` returns `iswatchonly: false` for every address. It was kept and marked '(DEPRECATED)' so it could be removed later without surprising users... but it was never put behind `-deprecatedrpc`." (PR description)
Release notes for v30 claimed the field was already removed from all RPCs, while `getaddressinfo` still emitted it. (PR description, commit 375dc869d8)
result.changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the patch and approach remain identical to the previous version.
result.card: Gates the `iswatchonly` return field of `getaddressinfo` behind `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly` prior to its full removal in a subsequent release. Since watch-only wallet functionality was removed in #32618, this field has been hardcoded to return false for all addresses, but it was never placed behind the standard RPC deprecation flag. External clients that strictly expect `iswatchonly` in `getaddressinfo` responses will need to provide the configuration flag or update their response parsing.

risk.why: External applications strictly parsing `getaddressinfo` outputs without optional-field handling could fail if the node is run without `-deprecatedrpc=iswatchonly`.
